$comment: Creatures (docs/adr/0073-creatures.md, CHARACTERS.md §11.6): animals as light server entities that wander, spawned near players by `rules` and removed far from all of them. A creature: its skinned `model` (shared/models/models.json), its walking speed (m/s), how far it wanders per walk (`wanderM`), how long it idles between walks (`idleSeconds` [min, max]), how many rows tall it is (`rows`: the open cells it needs over its ground), and the most rows it steps up (`climbRows`) or down (`dropRows`) in one step: a steeper edge (a cliff) or water stops it. A rule: the `creature`, the full blocks its ground may be (`on`), the share of the chunk columns near players that get a group (`chance`, rolled once per chunk column and face from the world seed: the same chunk always rolls the same), and the group's size (`group` [min, max]); `mix` (optional) lists other creatures a group may hold, each part rolled once a group with its `chance` and putting up to `max` of that creature in place of the rule's own (the deer: herds of does, sometimes with one stag). `limits`: chunks around each player that spawn (`spawnChunks`), the distance past which a creature with no player near is removed (`despawnM`), and the most in the world (`max`). An NPC (WORK_QUEUE item 38, CHARACTERS.md §11.10) is a creature with an `npc` block: `lookAtM` (it turns, at `turnDegPerS`, to face a player that near while idling), `bumpM` and `sidestepM` (a player or NPC that near makes it step that far aside), `idles` (the idle poses it picks by `weight`: stand, look around or sit, each for `seconds` [min, max], in place of `idleSeconds`) `held` (optional: the item in its hand, on the model's hand joint; the sword once it is an item, WORK_QUEUE item 35), `disposition` (`neutral`, the default: it starts no fight), `combat` (the hook when attacked: `none` or `fightBack`, it turns on its attacker) and `colours` (per part, the palette ramp of its model's mesh it replaces, `from`, and the ramps one is picked from, `to`, seeded per NPC). A rule's optional `spacingM` keeps a group that far from any other of its kind, and `biomes` (names in shared/worldgen/biomes) limits it to columns of those biomes (worlds with no biome map skip the check). Only the deer (does, sometimes with a stag), the wolves and the villagers spawn for now (owner, 2026-11-10: "let's disable all the animals except wolves and deer for now"): the horse and the chicken are listed but have no rule. Prototype content (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1). Run `node shared/creatures/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-sim/src/creatures.gen.rs is stale.
